answer_1.quote: We investigate the co-temporal reasoning abilities of large language models within two problem settings: (1) Closed-Book QA (CBQA)... (2) In the Open-Book QA (OBQA) setting...
answer_1.outputs: The models generate answers to co-temporal questions, such as identifying positions held during overlapping time periods.

answer_2.quote: Following , we adopt a stricter Acc. score, where a prediction is correct only if it aligns with all the gold answers for a question. Additionally, we also evaluate our methods by answer-level F 1 score (F 1 ), which is a stricter metric compared to token-level F 1 score.

answer_4.quote: We report human performance to serve as an upper bound.
answer_4.guideline: Human performance is reported as an upper bound, implying that human annotators answered the same questions under the same conditions.
